About Us
--------

![Image 3](https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/05b843eb-228e-4ade-88a3-9cae36cea44c/IMG_0705.jpg/:/cr=t:14.14%25,l:0%25,w:100%25,h:71.72%25/rs=w:600,h:600,cg:true)

#### Who We Are

We are a Muay Thai and Boxing Gym located in the center of the DFW area.The Club was established in 1996 – Since then we have had 20 continuous years of teaching and training, appealing to both fighters (Amateur and Professional)and recreational athletes.Students and athletes from all walks of life come to train for various reasons, some come for the love of the sport, others enjoy learning about the intricacy of “the Sweet Science”. Whether you are looking

 to get into the best shape of your life, learn self defense or are interested in competing on the amateur or professional levels,we will help you achieve your personal goals.

![Image 4](https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/05b843eb-228e-4ade-88a3-9cae36cea44c/IMG_0696.jpg/:/cr=t:22.95%25,l:0%25,w:100%25,h:74.96%25/rs=w:600,h:600,cg:true)

#### Your Success is Our Goal

Our goal has always been to become the number one stand up striking training center in the DFW area. In 2010 we relocated to the current facility – A standalone, 6,000 sq.ft. building, designed and built from the ground to be a high quality Muay Thai and Boxing gym.

![Image 5](https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/05b843eb-228e-4ade-88a3-9cae36cea44c/IMG_0680_jpg.jpg/:/cr=t:13.24%25,l:0%25,w:100%25,h:73.52%25/rs=w:600,h:600,cg:true)

#### Programs

We have a wide array of programs to meet your interests.We specialize in Muay Thai, Boxing, and MMA. We have also added wrestling and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu to our schedule, both of which are taught by some of the most experienced instructors in the area.We are located on the Southeast corner of MacArthur Blvd & Valley Ranch Parkway South
